text: Skip to main content How to create an account to use IRS Free File Fillable Forms - YouTube video text script More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Multimedia center Social media American Sign Language (ASL) Radio PSAs Tax articles to share Posters to share If you aren't eligible to file your taxes for free through the IRS Free File program, you can still file for free using Free File Fillable Forms. These are electronic federal tax forms you can fill out and file online at no charge. To get started, go to IRS.gov/freefile and click on "Use Free File Fillable Forms". On the page, you'll find helpful links to review before starting. Complete the form to create an account. Your safety is always our priority so you'll need to verify both your email address and mobile phone number. Be sure to respond to the verification email and text messages before getting started on your tax return. The Free File Fillable Forms User's Guide has more information about navigating through the application and successfully e-filing your federal tax return. To get started with Free File Fillable Forms, go to IRS.gov/freefile . Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 23-Jan-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print
